visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight light-brown hair, wearing a stylish beige utility jacket over a white T-shirt with a floral print, stands on a bustling Japanese city street at dusk. She looks directly into the camera with an expressive, smiling face, gesturing dynamically with her hands. Behind her, bright yellow and blue signs for "Matsumoto Kiyoshi" and "AOKI" are prominent against a background of urban buildings and soft artificial lighting. (2) The scene shifts to the woman entering a brightly lit drugstore interior, where she walks past rows of densely packed shelves filled with colorful cosmetic and healthcare products. She wears a brown backpack and continues to address the camera with high energy. The setting is clean and commercial, with fluorescent lighting illuminating the various product packages in the background. (3) The woman holds a blue, shiny bottle of Skin Aqua sunscreen close to the camera, demonstrating its application on the back of her hand. Her facial expressions are animated as she speaks, emphasizing the product's features. Large pink and white text overlays appear at the bottom and top of the frame. The background remains the blurred shelves of the drugstore. (4) Transitioning to a different aisle, the woman highlights a green tube of Acnes 25 medical cream. She holds the product up for a clear view, then the camera cuts to a close-up of her applying a small amount of the white cream to her chin. Her gestures are precise and intentional, showing the texture of the product against her skin. (5) In a change of setting, the woman is seen indoors, possibly a hotel room or studio, wearing a cute blue headband with white ears. She and a man with short brown hair are both wearing white face masks from a pink Calamee packet. They look happy and relaxed, patting the masks onto their skin. The lighting is soft and warm, creating a personal, lifestyle-oriented atmosphere.
